name: Kreativ Smart Related Posts
description: Help readers discover related posts using categories and tags, with optional AI re-ranking.
cardUse: Show relevant articles automatically or with a block or shortcode.
metaDescription: Display related posts with taxonomy matching, flexible layouts, and optional AI re-ranking.

detailItems.title: Relevant posts, ready to show
detailItems.body: Match published posts by shared categories and tags. Display recommendations automatically after posts, or place them with a block or shortcode.

detailItems.title: Make the layout your own
detailItems.body: Choose a grid, list, or minimal layout, customize the display, and pin or exclude posts from the editor.

detailItems.title: Optional AI re-ranking
detailItems.body: Taxonomy matching works without an AI provider or API key. Optional background AI re-ranking uses the WordPress AI Client, requires WordPress 7.0 or later and a configured provider, and is disabled by default.

items.title: You choose whether to use AI
items.body: If you enable AI re-ranking, source post titles and excerpts and candidate post details are sent to the provider configured through the WordPress AI Client. Review that provider’s privacy terms before enabling it.

quickStart: Install Kreativ Smart Related Posts from Plugins → Add New Plugin, or upload the ZIP, then activate it.
Configure the related-post display in the plugin settings. Use automatic placement, the block, or a shortcode.
Review the result on a published post and adjust the layout or pin and exclude posts in the editor.
If you want AI re-ranking, configure a WordPress AI provider and enable it explicitly.
